name: Plav in a day
description_md:
Plav in a day is a waymarked hiking route located in ME. The trail covers a distance of 10.7 km and requires about 5.3 hours of walking time based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This route is categorized as a waymarked hiking route. It is situated within the country of ME.
